title: onX Hunt Scouting-to-Harvest Lag
dataSources: Catch trips (`outdoor:trip`), hunt map activity (`hunt:map`), foraging observations (`forage:observation`), smoker sessions (`cook:smoker`), harvest queues (`outdoor:queue`).
app: Fishing, hunting, foraging, and outdoor-cooking telemetry — Fishbrain catch logs, onX Hunt map exports, iNaturalist observations, and ThermoWorks smoker probes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hunt:map zone=* scouting_epoch=* harvest_epoch=* harvest_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((harvest_epoch-scouting_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by zone
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures scouting-to-harvest lag by hunt zone for scouting workflows.
value: Lag tracking shows which hunt zone create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside scouting workflows.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `scouting-to-harvest lag` on `hunt:map` events and aggregate them by `zone`.
visualization: Table of hunt zone with average and worst scouting-to-harvest lag.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how long things take for each hunt zone so you can see where scouting workflows slows down.
